CustomField.description: The next time this job is due on the job runner: the first fire time of its expression, in its time zone, after the check that last started or skipped it. Written by the framework; edits to the expression, time zone, mode or active flag reset it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Written by the framework; do not edit. The job runs at the first runner check on or after this time.
CustomField.label: Next Run At
